newsitem.title: USA: CPAC says Q4 will again be weakest of year.
newsitem.headline: CPAC says Q4 will again be weakest of year.

text.p: CPAC Inc said it expects the fourth quarter to be its weakest quarter of the year because of regular seasonal trends.
"Historically the fourth quarter is CPAC's weakest quarter, and we expect that to be so again this year," the company's chief executive, Thomas Henderson, said.
Henderson added that, "We remain confident that the year will end with strong sales and earnings performance over last year."
The company did not provide specific figures and officials there were not immediately available to comment.
CPAC, Inc. is a worldwide specialty chemical manufacturer which makes both personal care and cleaning products.
